methods.title: Identify positive square roots
steps: The radicands are $(\sqrt2+1)^2$ and $(\sqrt2-1)^2$. Both quantities before squaring are positive. Taking the principal roots and subtracting yields $(\sqrt2+1)-(\sqrt2-1)=2$.
stepsZh: 根号内分别为 $(\sqrt2+1)^2$ 和 $(\sqrt2-1)^2$。因 $\sqrt2>1$，两个括号内的数都为正，开方后相减得 $(\sqrt2+1)-(\sqrt2-1)=2$。
